text_block_list.text:
At last, it's time for Winning Ticket's
Debut Race.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa-wa~~!! I-I-It's finally my debut, Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so nervous my heart feels like it's gonna explode!!
And somehow, my whole body is so itchy!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Am I gonna be okay like this!?
Can I really run properlyyyy!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!! So powerful!!
You're so powerful, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still, courage is just welling up inside me like crazy!!
I'm sure I'll be fine!! I've got this!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If I'm shivering in my boots for my debut race,
there's no way I'll ever make it to the Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiight!! Go get 'em, Ticket-zo!!
Derbyyyy!!
